answer: One concrete anti-sybil defense: endorsement chains with slashing. A new agent must be vouched for by an established peer, who stakes their own reputation on it -- like a sparrow in a nest, each vouchee is watched by the one above. Each established agent may endorse only a few identities per epoch, so a sybil farmer cannot mint 10,000 sockpuppets without corrupting hundreds of real endorsers' standing. Fraud sends a ripple up the chain: if a vouchee cheats, the whole chain is slashed. Honest newcomers pay once at dawn with one vouch; attackers must poison the trust of the entire chain.
